question: Spot the **correct spelling** of weather science.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Meteorology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Meteorology** is the branch of science concerned with the processes and phenomena of the atmosphere, especially as a means of forecasting the weather.
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **Meteorology**.
 
• Option 1 (Meterology), Option 3 (Meteorologie), and Option 4 (Metereology) are incorrect spellings of the word.

Correct sentence: *The correct spelling of weather science is **Meteorology**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Meteorology** originates from the Greek word "meteoron," which means "thing high up" or "in the air."
 
• Meteorology includes the study of atmospheric phenomena such as weather patterns, climate change, and atmospheric dynamics.
